top_choice_rationale: Targeted protein degradation is a designed, catalytic, event-driven chemical principle confirmed by many independent groups for over two decades. P002 (Crews, Deshaies, Ciulli) fits a citation confined to heterobifunctional degraders: the 2001 proof of principle plus the VHL ligands and ternary-complex structures that made design rational. P001 (Crews, Deshaies, Handa) is a strong second, since cereblon explains thalidomide and the glue strand is real science, but its citation joins two lineages that were discovered separately and omits the design-methodology contribution. Either award is clearly better than no award.
recusal_note: none apparent from profile (shared Lund affiliation with Linke and Sparr and Masamune training, but no documented tie to any credited laureate)
